messages:
eve (Marketing): Quick sync: aiming to publish the 'Tide' release post Tue 09:30am PT. Need canonical docs URL, final changelog, a 1-paragraph bench blurb + 3 bullets, and a staging webhook for webinar registrations by EOD tomorrow.
raj (Engineering): On changelog PR #9824. Will include staged canary windows, rollback CLI, and a small Dedicated migration example.
mira (Docs): I can publish /docs/tide-release after the PR merges. Please put final example config in the changelog PR so I can copy it to the migration section.
felix (Product): Webinar confirmed Wed 11am PT. Marketing wants a 1-line promo (<=25 words), a 40-word bench blurb for the landing, and 3 bullets for the slide. Also need inbound mapping to SFDC fields for registrants (owner, campaign, source).
raj (Engineering): Draft bench para: "Tide trims median latency ~30% on long-context prompts and reduces per-token cost ~28% through adaptive batching and quant-aware kernels; includes an optional prefix-cache for steady p95 under load."
raj (Engineering): Bullets: 1) ~30% median latency improvement (8k), 2) ~28% per-token cost reduction with batching+quant, 3) optional prefix-cache for stable p95 on hot sessions.
eve (Marketing): Nice. Can you shorten the paragraph to ~40 words and provide a one-line promo for the webinar? Also paste the exact canary schedule + rollback command for the post.
raj (Engineering): Promo (<=25w): "Tide: faster responses, lower inference cost  live demo + migration tips." Canary: 10% -> 30% at 20m -> 70% at 75m -> 100% at 3h if metrics OK. Rollback: `rictl rollback --release tide --to previous`.
mira (Docs): Will publish canonical /docs/tide-release and drop the link here once PR merges. ETA tomorrow AM.
eve (Marketing): Ops, can we get a staging webhook for registrations: need test endpoint + API key to validate SFDC mapping.
ops-bot: Staging webhook created: https://hooks.staging.redwood/growth/tide-reg  test key expires in 7d. Mapping: lead.owner, lead.campaign, lead.source available.
eve (Marketing): Perfect  I'll lock the post draft tonight and update the promo copy once the docs URL is posted. Felix, I'll DM the slide draft for review.
felix (Product): Thanks — I'll check slides Tue night and confirm.
raj (Engineering): Putting migration snippet in changelog now; will ping when PR merged.
mira (Docs): Merged and published: canonical link https://docs.redwood.com/release/tide. Dropping it here for the post.
eve (Marketing): Got it, thanks! Locking publish time Tue 09:30am PT and scheduling webinar promo Wed AM. :rocket:
